subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct about Urs at Ajmer Sharif?

options.text: It follows the lunar calendar and marks the saint's death.
It is celebrated annually based on the solar calendar.
It marks the birth anniversary of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti.
It is held only once every five years during Ramzan.

solution:
The Correct answer is __**It follows the lunar calendar and marks the saint's death**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Urs** at Ajmer Sharif is an annual festival commemorating the death anniversary of **Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti**, a revered Sufi saint.
 
• The term **Urs** means "wedding" in Arabic, symbolizing the union of the saint's soul with the divine.
 
• It is observed based on the **lunar calendar**, particularly during the first six days of the Islamic month of **Rajab**.
 
• The festival involves religious rituals, prayers, and devotional music, attracting thousands of pilgrims from **India and abroad**.
 
• The shrine of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti, also known as the **Dargah Sharif**, is located in **Ajmer, Rajasthan.**
 
• Visitors offer **chadars (sacred cloth)** to the saint's tomb as an act of reverence and devotion.
 
• Various cultural and spiritual events, including **qawwali performances**, are held during the Urs, creating a vibrant and inclusive atmosphere.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Option 2: "It is celebrated annually based on the solar calendar"**__

 __
 
• The **solar calendar** is not used for determining the dates of Islamic festivals, which follow the **lunar calendar**.
 
• Islamic months are shorter than Gregorian months, leading to variations in annual dates.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "It marks the birth anniversary of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti"**__
 __
 
• Urs specifically marks the **death anniversary** of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti, not his birth anniversary.
 
• The term "Urs" is a celebration of spiritual union with the divine, which is associated with death rather than birth.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "It is held only once every five years during Ramzan"**__
 
 
• Urs is an **annual event** and is not tied to the month of **Ramzan**.
 
• It is observed in the month of **Rajab**, which is different from Ramzan.
